Degan Construction LLC, a family owned company, was founded in 2007 as a general contractor specializing in concrete work in the Phoenix area. Since then, the company has grown to incorporate many other types of construction including underground, wet utilities, and masonry. Operations have included work on mines, industrial infrastructure, recreational parks, roads, an array of commercial and government infrastructures. From the time they began, customer service has set Degan apart from surrounding competitors. Though the company services an array of projects from capital improvement developments to residential projects, their core focus is client satisfaction and exceeding customer’s expectations in a timely manner. 
We self perform all types of concrete construction including large scale flatwork, footings and foundations, site work, structural concrete and concrete repairs including epoxy injection and carbon fiber. We have an underground wet utilities division that has the capability of constructing and repairing water mainlines and services, sewer line installations and repairs, manhole construction and repair, lift stations, pump stations, wet & dry wells, storm drains, and inlet and outlet structures. Our masonry division has the capability of building complex building structures, retaining walls, stem walls, all types of fences and masonry repairs. We emphasize safety on all of our projects and have an excellent record.
